case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 5622 OF 2009, WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 8026 OF 2022

parties.respondent: M/S VIDEOCON INDUSTRIES LTD. THR. ITS DIRECTOR, M/S HARMAN INTERNATIONAL (INDIA) PVT. LTD.

summary: Classification dispute: LCD panels for TVs and car audio systems; issue: whether classifiable under CH 9013.8010 (liquid crystal devices) vs CH 8529/8522 (parts of TV/audio equipment); standard: commercial identity test over functional use; revenue's reliance on G.S. Auto (parts classification) distinguished; CESTAT's finding on specific classification in CH 9013 upheld; impugned orders allowed to sustain original classification favored by assesses.
legal_provisions_cited: G.S. Auto International Ltd v Collector of Central Excise
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; CESTAT orders upheld; classification of LCD panels under CH 9013.8010 sustained; revenue's contention rejected.
